fusions.name: Crushing Depth
fusions.desc: Crushes the target for 14 damage, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Churned Silt
fusions.desc: Drives a surge of silt in a cone 5 tiles long ahead of you, dealing 30 damage to everything in it, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health. Each hit has a 60% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Burrowed in Mud
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 35% for 10 seconds, and your water resistance by 10%.

fusions.name: Bedded Spines
fusions.desc: 10% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.
